title: AQLoRA: A Zero-Search Recipe for Fast Quantized LoRA Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2608.23816v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantized fine-tuning (QLoRA) saves memory but not time. It dequantizes every 4-bit weight on the fly, so it trains more slowly than fp16 LoRA. We present AQLoRA (Adaptive-Quantization LoRA), a recipe that buys part of that time back. One CPU pass over the weights sets everything, with no search and no calibration data. The pass ranks layers by NF4 reconstruction error and keeps the top-K in fp16 under a memory budget. Those layers skip dequantization, which is where the speed comes from. A quality setting adapts every layer. A speed setting adapts only the top blocks, so the backward pass stops early. The rule reproduces Unsloth's hand-curated dynamic-4bit selection exactly, in seconds, where search-based allocation needs repeated calibration passes.   We evaluate on Commonsense-170K across six models and four architecture families, from 1.4B to 14B. The speed setting trains 11.1 +/- 2.7% faster than well-tuned QLoRA and gives up about

translated_title: AQLoRA：一种零搜索的快速量化LoRA微调方案
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23816v1 公告类型：新 摘要：量化微调（QLoRA）节省内存但不节省时间。它动态地将每个4位权重反量化，因此训练速度比fp16 LoRA慢。我们提出了AQLoRA（自适应量化LoRA），一种能部分挽回时间的方案。对权重进行一次CPU遍历即可设置所有内容，无需搜索和校准数据。该遍历根据NF4重建误差对层进行排序，并在内存预算下将前K个层保持在fp16中。这些层跳过反量化，这正是速度提升的来源。质量设置适应每一层。速度设置仅适应顶层块，因此反向传播提前停止。该规则能在几秒内精确复现Unsloth的手工动态4位选择，而基于搜索的分配需要重复校准遍历。我们在Commonsense-170K上对六种模型和四种架构家族（从1.4B到14B）进行评估。速度设置比调优良好的QLoRA训练速度快11.1±2.7%，并牺牲约[此处省略部分内容]。
tldr: AQLoRA通过一次CPU遍历按重建误差选择层保留在fp16，避免反量化，实现了比QLoRA快约11%的训练速度，且无需搜索或校准数据。
en_tdlr: AQLoRA speeds up QLoRA fine-tuning by about 11% by using a single CPU pass to select layers kept in fp16 based on reconstruction error, avoiding dequantization without search or calibration data.
